source: Level up your pets faster by gaining XP in their favorite skill!
loreParagraphs.translation: 获取宠物擅长技能的经验,让它更快升级!

source: View and edit preset armor and equipment sets with other settings to make switching activities easy.
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看并编辑护甲、装备和其他设置的预设,方便切换不同活动.

source: Stats that influence what you catch and how quickly you catch it while fishing.
loreParagraphs.translation: 这些属性会影响钓获的种类和钓鱼速度.

loreParagraphs.translation: 你的拍卖共收到 {count} 次出价,总计 {value} 硬币.

source: You already have a Slayer Quest active! Cancel it first!
loreParagraphs.translation: 你已有进行中的杀手任务! 请先取消当前任务!

source: Match the attunement on your dagger to damage the boss.
loreParagraphs.translation: 切换匕首的协调属性,使其与首领一致才能造成伤害。

source: Deals {a}/{b}/{c} True Damage at {d}/{e}/{f} Boss Health respectively every second.
loreParagraphs.translation: 首领生命值分别为 {d}/{e}/{f} 时,每秒造成 {a}/{b}/{c} 点真实伤害。

source: View all of your SkyBlock progress, including your Skills, Collections, Recipes, and more!
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看你的 SkyBlock 进度,包括技能、收藏、配方等!

source: You can report this island if you think it has an inappropriate name.
loreParagraphs.translation: 如果你认为此岛屿名称不合适,可以进行举报.

source: Access the Garden's Desk to customize your plot, purchase items and unlock unique farming progression.
loreParagraphs.translation: 打开花园书桌,管理地块、购买物品并解锁农业成长内容.

source: Your Heart of the Mountain contains your progression for the deeper layers of the Deep Caverns!
loreParagraphs.translation: 山峰之心记录了你在深层矿洞中的探索进度!

source: Unlock Tiers by completing Commissions and upgrade perks using Powder.
loreParagraphs.translation: 完成委托解锁层级,使用粉末升级技能.

source: Your Heart of the Forest contains your progression for the Foraging Islands.
loreParagraphs.translation: 森林之心记录了你在采伐群岛中的成长进度.

source: Unlock Tiers by participating in Starlyn Contests and upgrade perks using Forest Whispers.
loreParagraphs.translation: 参加 Starlyn 竞赛解锁层级,使用森林低语升级技能.

source: View your equipment, stats, achievements, and more!
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看你的装备、属性、成就等!

source: View your Skill progression and rewards.
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看你的技能进度与奖励.
技能平均等级 {value} (不含装饰技能)

source: View all of the items available in SkyBlock. Collect more of an item to unlock rewards on your way to becoming a master of SkyBlock!
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看 SkyBlock 中的物品.收集更多同类物品,解锁收藏奖励,逐步精通 SkyBlock!

source: Through your adventure, you will unlock recipes for all kinds of special items! You can view how to craft these items here.
loreParagraphs.translation: 冒险中可以解锁各类特殊物品的配方!在这里查看制作方法.

source: Determine how far you've progressed in SkyBlock and earn rewards from completing unique tasks.
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看你的 SkyBlock 成长进度,完成各项任务获取奖励.

source: Each island has its own series of Chapters for you to complete!
loreParagraphs.translation: 每座岛屿都有专属的章节等待你完成!

source: Complete tasks within a Chapter to earn small rewards, or complete entire Chapters to earn big ones!
loreParagraphs.translation: 完成章节内的任务可获得奖励,完成整个章节可获得更丰厚的奖励!

source: Some islands also have Quests for you to complete! Some items can only be obtained through Quests!
loreParagraphs.translation: 部分岛屿还提供任务!某些物品只能通过任务获得!

source: View the SkyBlock Calendar, upcoming events, and event rewards!
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看 SkyBlock 日历、即将举行的活动及活动奖励!

source: Store global items that you want to access at any time from anywhere here.
loreParagraphs.translation: 存放物品,随时随地取用.

source: Different bags allow you to store many different items inside!
loreParagraphs.translation: 不同的随身袋可存放不同种类的物品!

source: View and manage all your Pets.
Level up your pets faster by gaining xp in their favorite Skill!
loreParagraphs.translation: 获取宠物对应技能的经验,使其更快升级!

source: Store armor sets and quickly swap between them!
loreParagraphs.translation: 存放成套盔甲,快速切换穿戴!
随时随地联系银行职员.

source: Teleport to islands you've already visited.
loreParagraphs.translation: 传送到已经到访的岛屿.

source: You can have multiple SkyBlock Profiles at the same time.
loreParagraphs.translation: 你可以同时拥有多个 SkyBlock 档案.

source: Each profile has its own island, inventory, quest log...
loreParagraphs.translation: 每个档案都有独立的岛屿、背包和任务日志等.
使用 /coopadd <name> 与好友合作游玩!

source: View and edit your SkyBlock settings.
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看并修改你的 SkyBlock 设置.

source: Obtain the Cookie Buff from Booster Cookies in the hub's community shop.
loreParagraphs.translation: 在主岛社区商店获取增益曲奇,享受曲奇增益.

loreParagraphs.translation: 用来存放其他储物袋的总袋!

loreParagraphs.translation: 存放各种鱼、鱼饵和钓鱼战利品的袋子!

loreParagraphs.translation: 精制箭袋,可存放各种弹药!

loreParagraphs.translation: 可存放护符、戒指、神器和能量球的特殊袋子!放入后仍可生效!

loreParagraphs.translation: 存放随时间成长的物品,袋内时间流速为两倍!

source: Click an item in your inventory!
Find items for sale by players across Hypixel SkyBlock!
loreParagraphs.translation: 浏览 Hypixel SkyBlock 玩家出售的物品!

source: Items offered here are for auction, meaning you have to place the top bid to acquire them!
loreParagraphs.translation: 这里的物品采用竞拍方式,最高出价者可获得物品!

source: Set your own items on auction for other players to purchase.
loreParagraphs.translation: 将你的物品上架拍卖,供其他玩家购买.

source: View various statistics about you and the Auction House.
loreParagraphs.translation: 查看你的拍卖行相关统计.

source: Increase your bid limit by achieving a higher SkyBlock Level!
loreParagraphs.translation: 提升 SkyBlock 等级可提高出价上限!

source: Click an item in your inventory to select it for this auction.
loreParagraphs.translation: 点击背包中的物品,将其选为本次拍卖的物品.

source: The minimum price a player can offer to obtain your item.
loreParagraphs.translation: 玩家竞拍此物品时的最低出价.

source: Once a player bids for your item, other players will have until the auction ends to make a higher bid.
loreParagraphs.translation: 有人出价后,其他玩家可在拍卖结束前继续加价.

source: How long players will be able to place bids for.
loreParagraphs.translation: 允许玩家参与竞拍的时长.

source: Note: Bids automatically increase the duration of auctions.
loreParagraphs.translation: 注意:出价会自动延长拍卖时长.

source: Set a price, then one player may buy the item at that price.
loreParagraphs.translation: 设定价格后,玩家即可按此价格直接购买物品.

source: The price at which you want to sell this item.
loreParagraphs.translation: 你希望出售此物品的价格.

source: With traditional auctions, multiple buyers compete for the item by bidding turn by turn.
loreParagraphs.translation: 传统拍卖中,多位买家通过轮流出价竞争物品.

source: Specify how long you want the auction to last.
loreParagraphs.translation: 设置本次拍卖的持续时长.

source: Find items by name, type, lore, or enchants.
loreParagraphs.translation: 按名称、类型、描述或附魔搜索物品.

source: You need to bid at least {value} coins to hold the top bid on this auction.
loreParagraphs.translation: 出价至少 {value} 硬币,才能成为当前最高出价者.

source: The top bid on auction end wins the item.
loreParagraphs.translation: 拍卖结束时,最高出价者获得物品.

source: If you do not win, you can claim your bid coins back.
loreParagraphs.translation: 如果未能拍得物品，可以领回出价时支付的硬币。

loreParagraphs.translation: 设置批量出售背包或储物袋物品时,是否跳过此商品.

loreParagraphs.translation: 管理批量出售时跳过的商品.

loreParagraphs.translation: 查看各商品的价格、订单量、近期成交和交易图表.

loreParagraphs.translation: 可在奇术师处学习能量的特殊物品.
